notes.title: Version 1.03 released !
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

We’re back with the biggest update that we have released so far since the game’s launch 2 months ago.

We've focused mostly on stability, with many major changes under the hood, but we also put a lot of work on balancing several areas of the game, like the tech tree and AI for example as well as fixing several bugs.

Here's the changelog for 1.03:

-Improved stability
-Story events races now start with 4 planets instead of 1
-The Arka'avi and Osian races now have much better technology, making them significantly harder to beat
-Raze planet crash fixed
-It's now harder to have the AI accept long term payment deals, making it much harder to lead the AI bankrupt by asking or giving several loans. Additionally it also takes its current debt into account when making a decision.
- Added new Background music track
- Implemented a series of experimental stability fixes
- Added Space Key to skip cinematic intro
- Going back from the game to the main menu now restarts the new game settings
- Made the AI use diplomacy more actively
- Rebalanced the tech research time of several technologies in all branches
- Added Plasma Weapon Z-IV technology and ship part
- Fixed non working Technology Level tooltip when a pirate faction is
selected in the Diplomacy menu
- Fixed non working Enter Key in initial intro
- Fixed General without weapons bug
- Fixed events that are triggered when right after starting a new session
- Fixed non working "Broken Chains" speech
- Fixed barely noticeable effect of the Emergency Chip, Improved
Medical Care and Pharmaceutics technolgies
- Fixed Minor Race menu not showing the state of your relations when
they really like you
- Fixed "too much weight" window bug when leaving the ship design menu
- Fixed non working Enter Key in initial intro
- Fixed "can't estabilish trade routes with empire X" due to embargo or war message popping up when trying to move a ship to one of your planets

As always, we are listening to your feedback and really appreciate any report of issues you may find.
That said, we really hope you enjoy this update !

Cheers !

notes.title: Lords of the Black Sun Beta 2.01 released ! (Update)
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

As the title implies, we have a brand new build for you guys and this one is a major build.
It includes several and important bug and crash fixes, new content such as technologies and ship parts but above all, the first version of the multiplayer.

Being the first build of the multiplayer being released to the masses, we expect people to stumble upon some bugs and crashes. As always we'd really appreciate any feedback you can give us on whatever you find.
Also it is only LAN and Internet/IP for the time being, but more on this later.

As for what else you can find, here's the changelog:

- Intelligence screen largerly improved. The window is significantly larger, showing more information and bigger and less cluttered text.

- First playable version of the Multiplayer. Expect bugs and possibly crashes. Anything you can report on that side would be greatly appreciated. At this moment it is Lan and Internet/IP only but we plan on implementing Steam Lobbies to make matchmaking much easier.

- New Technologies and ship parts, as well as rebalanced military tech tree.

- Improved combat mode and fixed several bugs related to it introduced in the last build, some of which made the combat almost unusable since the last build.

- UI changes/improvements: Now selecting a planet will indicate how much you can profit from trading with it, as well as how much others can profit from trading with your planets.

- Added a new option for Auto Save frequency. 

- Tentatively fixed several crashes related to beta 1.2.

- Some general bug fixing and overall balancing and polishing in several areas of the game.

Have fun !

EDIT:
We have just released a minor revision that fixes the game breaking issues with combat people had since the last two builds as well as some small but important additions. 

Full changelog:

- Fixed Can't attack during combat after 1st turn bug
- Fixed Keyboard input issues
- Rebalanced Tech tree, updated some ship parts and changed some things around (Improved ship range is in the science branch for example)
- Fixed Autosave not working issue
- Fixed some fonts in the main menu
- Fixed Selection panel vertical size issue
- Added Icon during combat indicated a ship hasn't attacked or defended yet
- Added Inverted Mouse Buttons option for people with left handed/inverted mouses

notes.title: Lords of the Black Sun Beta 1.1 is now live !
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

In this new build we introduce some major AI improvements, as well as add some significant depth to the trade system and some UI improvements. 
Some other aspects have rebalanced such as the economy, the number of building slots and the chances of finding worthwhile space debris, as well the usual batch of bug fixes.

Here's a list of what you can expect:

-AI now creates trade routes based on the relations with the owner of the target planet, resources and existing trade benefits such as trade agreement and trade consulate.
If they think they can find a more profitable deal elsewhere and/or the relations between both empires become lower they may abandon their current trade route and create a new one elsewhere.

-Trade Centers now have a much bigger impact on gameplay, making the local trade bonus apply to every empire involved in trade with the planet it's built in, making it a good way to attract potential traders.

- Added new Trade Subsidies proposal: Make it possible to negotiate how trade profit is split.

-AI's handling of economy has been greatly improved. Along with choosing trade routes very carefully, they will fire ministers and generals and build their military according to their economic situation for instance.

-Huge improvements on how the AI handles diplomacy, taking common enemies with a specific empire into account, imposing and lifting embargos strategically, interacting with the player in new ways, bullying empires they see as weaker than them or helping other empires if financially stable and with a common enemy for instance. It's also harder to upgrade relations.

-AI manages it's ships and fleets correctly now, sending unused ships to the orbit of nearby planets.

-Icons on the Diplomacy screen now show diplomatic state with other empires and existing trade routes, embassies, trade consulates and signed agreements with the player.

-The Negotiation menu has been tweaked to show all the possible proposals at a glance

-When trading, trade ships now show a Trading icon instead of the Unit icon(Triangle)

-Economy grows faster and is generally less frustrating to manage

-More chances of space debris having something valuable

-Planets now have less building slots, specially large and average sized planets, making each decision more important.

-Important bug fixes such as the game freezing on End Turn, the AI building massive numbers of freighters and Center on Trading Ship centering on invisible ships.

Have fun !

notes.title: Lords of the Black Sun is now Beta !
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

We are very pleased to announce that Lords of the Black Sun (previously known as Star Lords) has now entered BETA stage !

What this means for you as a player, is that development of the game has now reached a more advanced, (almost) feature complete, more polished stage. Over the past months we have worked hard to improve what the community felt was lacking when we first entered in Early Access ‘Alpha’ state back in December 2013, although never straying too far from the direction we set out on.

We worked very hard since the start of this project and for that we are proud, as well as very grateful to the community for the fantastic feedback we got. However there is still some way to go, and we hope to continue enjoying your support and patience, so that we can make certain that Lords of the Black Sun becomes the great space strategy game everyone wants it to be !

Here's a changelog of what you can expect from this new build:

- Improved AI: Now the AI fully uses the ship design component and its latest additions, designing more powerful ships and better managing its military forces making it a significantly tougher opponent.

- Major bug fixes and fixed some crashes and stability issues. Bug and crash fixes include the corrupted save files bug and the Trade Routes menu crash.

- Multiplayer is now being tested internally. While it's not available in this first beta release, it will be included as soon as we are confident enough with what we have, namely in the coming builds.

- Added revamped Light and Medium Draakian ships models

Cheers and hope everyone enjoys this new update !

PS: We are raising the price now that we have reached Beta version, but it is still cheaper than the final launch price will be, so don’t wait too long !

notes.title: Alpha 19.0 is live !
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

Here's a brand new build that introduces one major concept but mostly fixes several major bugs, and hopes to improve overall stability.

Here's the changelog:

-New immigration concept: Citizens from other empires can now migrate to your colonies and vice
versa, depending on several factors such as the living conditions, taxes and overall happiness of both your colonies and their native empire.
Immigration plays an important role on diplomacy and espionage and foreign grants for specific planets can be negotiated with other empires to ensure faster population growth.

- Major optimization in several areas of the game, major bug fixes and a tentative fix for the stability issues reported by several players. Some of the bug fixes include monthly payments, and missing generals in the Generals menu.

- Did some balancing on a few areas. For example, units can travel farther each turn and embassy and trade consulates won't have such a big impact on relations as they previously had, making it too easy to get another player to like you and arrange good deals.

- Updated galaxy view icons and symbol graphics for every race in the game.
 
As always, your feedback is very important for us so if you were one of those affected by these issues please let us know if this build fixed or at least improved the problem for you and if you noticed the framerate improvements.

Thanks !

notes.title: Alpha 18.0 is live !
notes.content:
Hello Space Guv’nors !
 
We are back with a major new build: Alpha 18 ! This new build should kill off those dreaded stability issues introduced back in Alpha 17, and also adds a bunch of improvements and major new features.
 
Here's what you can expect:
 
- A budget adjustment screen is now available. You can now adjust the budget for crime, health and propaganda (if you have the respective domestic policy enabled), as well as research and social welfare. All this makes your economy more easily manageable and adds some more depth when it comes to empire managment.
 
- Added Social Welfare concept: The larger your population, the more expensive social welfare becomes. This helps balance mass colonization and can also be used as a means to fight poverty, strikes and rebel attacks for instance.
 
- Fixed stability issues. Due to people having so many different PC configurations we still need to check if everyone is able to play the game normally, so as always your feedback is very important for us.
 
- Renewed ship design component: We added a lot more depth to the ship design component and greatly improved the UI, with the possibility for instance to add more than one weapon in one ship. This isn't final and there are some placeholder graphics but all this will be addressed in the coming builds.
 
- We got rid of the double clicking to go the galaxy view, and got rid of the previous zoom limit, making it possible to play the game however you want.
 
- Balancing: ships move faster and can move further each turn than in the last builds, and taxing is more profitable than ever.
 
- Added several new random events.
 
- A new batch of bug fixes.

As always, we are looking forward to your feedback and thanks a lot for all the feedback we got so far. :)

Cheers !

notes.title: Alpha 17.0 is now live !
notes.content:
Hello there everyone !
 
We're back with a new Alpha build, introducing some major new features, improvements and important changes and bug fixes.
 
Here's a list of what you can expect from Alpha 17.0:
 
- Added Embassy and Trade Consulate concepts in diplomacy: An Embassy and a Trade Consulate is needed in a planet belonging to one of the parties to unlock certain deals such as an Alliance or a Free Trade agreement.

- Added Threats in Diplomatic Negotiations: Your Reputation plays an important on whether or not your threats will be taken seriously and can be used to get otherwise hardly accessible deals.

- Added Monitoring Diplomatic Activity intel mission: Your spies can now track when the target empire signs certain deals or when they propose to impose an embargo or declare war on another empire for instance.

- Added Trade Routes menu: This menu gives an overview of all the current trade routes you have with other empires.

- Improved the AI's handling of diplomacy and economy.

- Added a '?' icon next to the space debris, to make them more noticeable
.
- Added Shortcuts for camera control (Hold TAB to rotate the camera, Page Up and '+' keys to zoom in, Page Down and '-' keys to zoom out)

- Added 'Total War' game option: All the players start at war with each other.

- Bug fixing: Fixed several minor and major bugs, including a couple of crashes (including the invasion crash), and the game stuck on AI turn bug.

- Balancing:  Ships have 20% more movepoints so they can move farther in less turns, and research is 20% faster. Greater accuracy in combat: Missing constantly isn't fun and could end up being frustrating so we tweaked the hit chances.

Have fun !

notes.title: Alpha 16.0 is live
notes.content:
Hello there,
 
We have just released Alpha 16.0, here's what you can expect from the new build:
 
- A new game creation screen: You now have a single menu with three tabs: Race Selection, Galaxy Settings and Game Settings. Each of these tabs has been greatly improved from the previous menus, with less cluttered and better organized information.
 
- Stability improvement: We implemented a series of experimental fixes that should fix most (if not all) stability issues. Regretfully,  of these experimental fixes involved temporarily removing the weapon and armor ship parts from the game. These will be reinstated in a later build. It's very important for us to know if these fixes are working in a variety of PC configurations, so any feedback on whether or not the game still crashes for you is very important for us.
 
- The domestic policies mechanic has been fleshed out and further balanced, with various random events having an impact on the population's approval of certain policies. Now, an event message box will pop up when the majority of the population disagrees with one of your policies.
 
- A new batch of bug fixes: among them, most (if not all) of the full-screen issues (such as the screen only displaying a part of the UI for example) should be fixed, the tutorial text is no longer out of bounds and the crashes on loading a game should be gone once and for all.
 
- Some general balancing has been done, most importantly,  every player now starts with 5000 BC, to make the early game more challenging, and exploration more rewarding, with valuable space debris having a bigger impact than before.

- Graphical Update: Improved backgrounds and updated the ship models for the Krifith Empire. More improvements in this aspect will be introduced incrementally.
 
We hope you like this new update, and have fun !

notes.title: Alpha 15.0 is up
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

This update took a bit longer than the last one but hopefully it will be worth the wait.

Here's what you can expect from the new build:

- Revamped UI visually. In addition to the visual changes, some menus have been improved such as the Colony Management menu. There's still some work left to do in this regard but we're looking forward to hear what you think so far.

-The Domestic Policies component has been finished and enabled. Other than having a impact on certain aspects of your empire and government form, some domestic policies can trigger certain events, while certain events can cause your population to approve or disapprove certain policies. 
The respective tutorial will be available in the next build.

-This build feature some important bug and crash fixes such as the AI not building fighters (bug introduced in the last build), some buttons such as the save and load buttons not working correctly, and the race portraits not being rendered correctly.

Hello everyone !

This update took a bit longer than the last one but hopefully it will be worth the wait.

Here's what you can expect from the new build:

-The Domestic Policies component has been finished and enabled. Other than having a impact on certain aspects of your empire and government form, some domestic policies can trigger certain events, while certain events can cause your population to approve or disapprove certain policies.

In the next build you can expect some new features, further UI and stability improvements. In the meantime and as always we're looking forward to hear what you think :)

Cheers !
